nodes.label: Favicon / Apple Touch Icon
nodes.summary: Browser favicon (favicon.svg, 64x64, rounded-corner rect rx=14) and iOS home-screen icon (apple-touch-icon.png), both rendering the teal square with the white person glyph.

nodes.label: Brand Teal #4F7C74
nodes.summary: Core brand colour: a muted teal-green, hex #4F7C74 (declared in favicon.svg), used as the icon background and as the 'psico' half of the wordmark.

nodes.label: Head + Leaf + Clipboard Iconography
nodes.summary: Visual motif combining a human head in profile (psychology / mind), a growing leafy branch (growth, wellbeing), and a clipboard with a checkmark (administration, invoicing, compliance) - encoding the app's purpose: practice management for psychology professionals.

nodes.label: Psicofactur App Icon (person glyph)
nodes.summary: App/launcher icon: a solid teal-green (#4F7C74) square with a white generic person glyph (circular head above a rounded shoulders/bust silhouette). Distinct from the illustrated brand logo; used as the compact icon form.

nodes.label: Psicofactur Brand Identity
nodes.summary: Brand for the 'psicofactur' app. Wordmark 'psicofactur' set in lowercase with 'psico' in teal and 'factur' in blue/purple. Tagline 'GESTION INTEGRAL PARA PROFESIONALES DE LA PSICOLOGIA'. Palette is teal-green shifting to blue/violet, on cream/off-white.

nodes.label: Psicofactur Full Logo
nodes.summary: Primary illustrated logo (logo-psicofactur.png): a circular badge with a cream fill and a teal-to-violet gradient ring. Centre shows a left-facing human head in profile with a leafy plant branch growing from it, beside a clipboard bearing checklist lines and a circled checkmark. Wordmark and tagline sit below.

nodes.label: PWA Installable Icons
nodes.summary: Progressive Web App icons: pwa-192.png and pwa-512.png (rounded-square teal tile with white person glyph) and pwa-maskable-512.png (full-bleed teal with the glyph inset in the safe zone for platform masking).

nodes.label: Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD)
nodes.summary: Spanish data protection supervisory authority to which data subjects can complain if processing does not comply with the rules (www.aepd.es).
nodes.norm_label: agencia espanola de proteccion de datos (aepd)

nodes.label: Automatic billing cron (facturar_citas_pasadas)
nodes.summary: Cron psicofactur-facturar-citas-pasadas (every 15 min, migration 0015) calls facturar_citas_pasadas() to create a draft factura row for every past, non-cancelled cita lacking one, importe = precio_sesion. Client also runs facturarSesionesPendientes on opening Facturacion.
nodes.source_location: Decisiones que conviene recordar > Facturacion automatica

nodes.label: Brevo (email delivery)
nodes.summary: Sends invoice and consent emails. Chosen over Resend because Brevo stores everything in the EU. Needs BREVO_API_KEY, BREVO_FROM, BREVO_FROM_NOMBRE secrets; replyTo is psicologas.email. Domain psicologaenlanzarote.com with DKIM/DMARC records.
nodes.source_location: ## La factura por correo > Por que Brevo y no Resend

nodes.label: Carlos Vizcaino Rigol (operator / data processor)
nodes.summary: The person who develops and operates Psicofactur non-commercially. Acts as data processor (encargado del tratamiento) for the professionals, and is data controller only for the login account and technical logs. Contact carlosvirigol@gmail.com.

nodes.label: Citas (appointments)
nodes.summary: Appointments with fecha_hora, duracion_minutos, estado_confirmacion, google_event_id. Couple sessions store paciente_id + acompanante_id. In supabase_realtime publication.
nodes.source_location: Decisiones que conviene recordar; Google Calendar

nodes.label: Confirmafy colour circles
nodes.summary: Third-party tool that prefixes calendar event titles with a coloured circle (green confirmed, yellow pending, red cancelled). The Google->app sync reads the circle to set citas.estado_confirmacion and never touches the circle.
nodes.source_location: Base de datos y sesion; Google Calendar > Los cambios hechos en Google

nodes.label: Consent token (consentimiento_token)
nodes.summary: 32 random bytes emailed to the patient; the sole authorisation for the public consent Edge Functions. Queries always go by token, never a browser-supplied id; the token is deleted in the same statement that saves the signature; it expires after 30 days (DIAS_VALIDEZ).
nodes.source_location: Consentimiento informado > El token es la llave

nodes.label: Supabase Edge Functions (Deno)
nodes.summary: Deno serverless functions in supabase/functions/ that mediate every external integration (Google OAuth, WhatsApp/Meta, Verifacti, Brevo email, consent tokens). Shared helpers live in _shared/.

nodes.label: eventos_google_pendientes
nodes.summary: Inbox for Google Calendar events that can't be auto-classified as appointments. Resolved at /revisar; rows are never deleted or the next sync would re-import the same event forever.

nodes.label: asignar_numero_factura() trigger
nodes.summary: DB trigger that assigns the invoice number from a per-psychologist, per-year counter (contadores_factura), producing 2026/0001, 2026/0002... CREATE SEQUENCE was rejected as global and non-resetting. Unique index facturas_numero_unico is the safety net.
nodes.source_location: Decisiones que conviene recordar > Numero de factura

nodes.label: Facturas (invoices)
nodes.summary: One invoice per session (unique index idx_facturas_cita_unica). Never deleted, only voided (estado_pago = 'cancelado') so the correlative numbering keeps every number.

nodes.label: RGPD / LOPDGDD / Ley 41/2002
nodes.summary: The consent clauses are written following the GDPR, the Spanish LOPDGDD and Ley 41/2002 (patient autonomy). Patients may complain to the AEPD; retention follows fiscal and health law.

nodes.label: Google Calendar integration
nodes.summary: Two-way sync between the practice agenda and Google Calendar. Authorised separately from login via Ajustes; all token exchange happens server-side in Edge Functions. sync-cita-a-google pushes on save; sincronizar-desde-google pulls changes with a syncToken.

nodes.label: google_credenciales + Supabase Vault
nodes.summary: Table holding Google OAuth tokens with RLS and no policies, so it doesn't exist for the browser. It stores only the id of an encrypted Vault secret; only Edge Functions with the service key reach it.
nodes.source_location: Google Calendar > Donde vive cada cosa

nodes.label: Google API Limited Use policy
nodes.summary: Psicofactur's use of Google API data follows the Google API Services User Data Policy including Limited Use: Calendar data used only for the agenda features, not transferred except to run the service, never used for ads, no human reads it save narrow exceptions.
nodes.source_location: 4. Uso limitado de los datos de Google (Limited Use)

nodes.label: Google OAuth scopes (calendar.events, openid email)
nodes.summary: Minimum scopes requested: calendar.events to create/edit events without seeing the rest of the calendar, and openid email only to show which account is connected. GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are Edge Function secrets, never in the browser .env.
nodes.source_location: Google Calendar > Como se conecta ella; privacidad.html 2.1

nodes.label: handle_new_user() / on_auth_user_created
nodes.summary: SECURITY DEFINER trigger that creates the psicologas row automatically when an auth user is registered, so no one can fabricate tenant rows from the client.
nodes.source_location: Base de datos y sesion > Alta de la psicologa

nodes.label: Special-category health data
nodes.summary: Practice data may include special-category (health) data to the extent essential for psychological care. Legal basis is the care relationship plus fiscal and health legal obligations.
nodes.source_location: 2.2. Datos de gestion de la consulta

nodes.label: Informed consent & data protection
nodes.summary: Digital replacement for the paper consent signed in the practice (migration 0018). Patient opens /consentimiento?token= (the only route outside RutaProtegida), enters DNI, ticks the box and signs with a finger. Three states: NO_ENVIADO, PENDIENTE, FIRMADO.
nodes.source_location: ## Consentimiento informado y proteccion de datos

nodes.label: Invoice by email
nodes.summary: Envelope button per invoice that emails the patient their PDF invoice (enviar-factura-email + Brevo). Destination address is read server-side from the patient record, not sent from the browser; the PDF travels from the browser in base64. Tracked in facturas.email_enviado_at / email_destinatario (migration 0017).
nodes.source_location: ## La factura por correo; Decisiones > La factura por correo al paciente

nodes.label: Lista de espera (waiting list)
nodes.summary: Who wants a slot in an already-full week (migration 0016). A freed slot is not a table but a future cita with estado_confirmacion = 'cancelada' and nothing on top of it; matching lives in lib/espera.js.
nodes.source_location: Decisiones que conviene recordar > Lista de espera

nodes.label: DNI/NIF letter validation (lib/nif.js)
nodes.summary: The DNI check letter is validated on both client (src/lib/nif.js) and server (inside consentimiento-firmar) - the only intentionally duplicated code - because a wrong DNI flows into pacientes.dni and then invoices, causing AEAT error 1239.
nodes.source_location: Consentimiento informado > El token es la llave

nodes.label: Pacientes (patients)
nodes.summary: Patient records with name, phone, email, DNI. Never deleted, only archived (activo = false). creado_desde = 'google' marks half-filled records created on import.
nodes.source_location: Capa de servicios; Importar y exportar pacientes

nodes.label: Patient import / export
nodes.summary: Import / Export button in Pacientes. Accepts real .xlsx (parsed with no library via DecompressionStream) and CSV, detected by leading bytes. Guesses column names via alias lists, normalises dates/phones/amounts, dedupes by DNI then phone then name, only fills gaps and batches inserts 100 at a time.

nodes.label: pg_cron + pg_net scheduling
nodes.summary: Postgres cron jobs (pg_cron) call Edge Functions over HTTP (pg_net), pulling the Supabase service-role key from Vault (secret clave_servicio_supabase). Used for the Google sync poll (every 10 min), WhatsApp auto-reminders (hourly, migration 0008) and auto-billing (every 15 min).
nodes.source_location: Google Calendar > Quien la dispara; Recordatorios > El envio automatico

nodes.label: Privacy Policy (privacidad.html)
nodes.summary: Static page at /privacidad.html explaining what data the app processes, why and for how long, with special detail on Google API data. Forms part of the Terms of Service.

nodes.label: Authorised psychologist (data controller)
nodes.summary: A psychology professional expressly authorised by the operator. Access is personal and non-transferable. Each is the data controller (responsable del tratamiento) for their practice's data and responsible for legality of the invoices they issue.
nodes.source_location: 2. Acceso y cuenta; 4. Obligaciones del profesional

nodes.label: Psicofactur
nodes.summary: PWA for running a psychology practice: patients, calendar, billing and WhatsApp reminders. Non-commercial, operated by one person for a small group of authorised psychologists.

nodes.label: psicologas (tenant row)
nodes.summary: Row representing the psychologist tenant. Has no INSERT policy; the row is created automatically by the on_auth_user_created trigger. Holds google_calendar_config, email and ajustes (JSONB).
nodes.source_location: Base de datos y sesion > Alta de la psicologa

nodes.label: PWA install
nodes.summary: Installable as an app: desktop via the Chrome/Edge address-bar icon, iPhone via Safari Share > Add to Home Screen (full screen). iOS meta tags (apple-mobile-web-app-*) and viewport-fit=cover for the iPhone safe area; Safari needs HTTPS to register the service worker.

nodes.label: Realtime citas subscription
nodes.summary: citas is in the supabase_realtime publication and suscribirCitas() refreshes the agenda and reminders panel automatically without reload.

nodes.label: recordatorios_whatsapp
nodes.summary: Send history for WhatsApp reminders. App only does INSERT; UPDATE (boton_pulsado) is done by the webhook with the service key. Unique index recordatorios_whatsapp_auto_unica prevents duplicate automatic reminders.

nodes.label: Multi-tenant RLS
nodes.summary: Every table carries psicologa_id and RLS policies filter by psicologa_id = auth.uid(). The public anon key is deliberately public; RLS is what protects the data.
nodes.source_location: Base de datos y sesion > Multi-tenant

nodes.label: Services layer (src/services)
nodes.summary: The only code that talks to Supabase. Each function returns { data, error }, never throws, and translates between DB snake_case (deFila/aFila) and UI camelCase.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.summary: Backend database and server logic (hosted in the EU). All four app sections run against Supabase with login and RLS; Edge Functions use the service key.
nodes.source_location: Base de datos y sesion; privacidad.html punto 5

nodes.label: sync_estado_confirmacion trigger
nodes.summary: DB trigger that writes citas.estado_confirmacion when recordatorios_whatsapp.boton_pulsado changes (confirmo -> confirmada, no_puedo -> cancelada). The frontend only reads that column (except reactivating a reprogrammed cancelled cita).

nodes.label: Terms of Service (condiciones.html)
nodes.summary: Static page at /condiciones.html governing use of Psicofactur. States the app is non-commercial, provided 'as is' with no uptime or support commitment, each professional is the data controller and responsible for their billing, governed by Spanish law.

nodes.label: Vercel
nodes.summary: Hosting for the web/static part of the app (pages and static files); the built dist/ folder is published there, with vercel.json rewriting routes to index.html.

nodes.label: Verifacti / Veri*Factu
nodes.summary: Registers invoices with the Spanish tax agency (AEAT) via Verifacti (Veri*Factu system) using the NIF and fiscal config the professional enters. The invoice-by-email button and Download only appear when verifactu_estado = 'Correcto'.
nodes.source_location: 5. Facturacion electronica; privacidad.html punto 5; README Decisiones

nodes.label: VERSION_CONSENTIMIENTO
nodes.summary: Version string of the accepted legal text, stored with each signature alongside date, IP and declared DNI. Must be bumped in both src/lib/consentimiento.js and supabase/functions/_shared/consentimiento.ts; already-signed records keep their own version.
nodes.source_location: Consentimiento informado > El token es la llave

nodes.label: WhatsApp reminders
nodes.summary: Appointment reminders with two modes chosen by the 'Enviar solo' switch: manual via wa.me link, or automatic from the server via the WhatsApp Business (Meta) API with an approved 'recordatorio_cita' template. Blocked externally by lack of a dedicated number and Meta account.

nodes.label: webhook-whatsapp
nodes.summary: Public Edge Function (verify_jwt = false) that receives Meta message/status callbacks. Authenticated by the X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body; reads req.text() not req.json(). Maps quick-reply button ids (CONFIRMAR_CITA_/CANCELAR_CITA_) to the appointment.
nodes.source_location: Recordatorios de WhatsApp > Seguridad del webhook
